ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Lectures in Entrepreneurship I. Fundamental concepts of entrepreneurship and commercialization of technology in new and existing businesses. Guest-speaker topics vary, but typically include: evaluation of technology and business ideas in general; commercializing new technogies; financing through private and public sources; legal issues; product development; marketing; and international business issues.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
